thread:
Amelia (Recruiter): FYI — Asha Patel is converting contractor->FT and starts Wed Apr 3. Remote in Berlin (CET). Need to coordinate I-9 verification, benefits enrollment, day-1 orientation host, and laptop courier hold.

raj (HR): Congrats! For I-9 we can do remote verification during her first week with a notary + video; legal prefers a notary attestation. Do we have vendor options in DE?

amelia (Recruiter): She mentioned background check ran under her maiden name (Asha Rao). CheckMate says they need an updated consent form with an 'also known as' line. I uploaded the corrected form id `CHK-4762` to the hires folder.

raj (HR): Thanks — can @Asha confirm via email that she consents to re-running the check under both names? Amelia, please send the corrected consent and cc HR so we can annotate.

dylan (IT): Laptop is in transit but courier placed a hold at the Berlin hub — tracking `UPS 1Z999AA10123456784`. They asked for a local contact for pickup. We can redirect to Satellite Office Mitte for same-day collection.

amelia (Recruiter): I've asked Asha if she can pick it up at the Satellite Office. If she can't, we'll schedule a doorstep courier. cc @sarah (People Ops) for any payment approvals.

sarah (People Ops): Please do not bill the candidate. We'll cover courier fees. @dylan mark device as 'pending activation' until I-9 is confirmed.

dylan (IT): Will set MDM hold — device will not auto-enroll until we flip the flag. Also adding the hub Wi‑Fi: `Redwood-BER`.

onboard-bot: new-hire packet sent to Asha (email) — benefits packet, payroll enrollment form, and step-by-step onboarding checklist.

raj (HR): Benefits orientation — propose 09:00 PST / 18:00 CET on Wed (same day). We'll record the session for US folks. Also schedule a 30-min 1:1 to walk local payroll + tax forms. @amelia please ask if Asha wants English-only or a German copy of the benefits summary.

amelia (Recruiter): She prefers English, but would like the benefits summary in German as a reference. I'll request that from benefits.

sarah (People Ops): I'll book the orientation and invite @maria (Benefits) for 18:00 CET. Note: Asha requested an ergonomic keyboard and live captioning for the session — adding accommodations now.

amelia (Recruiter): Quick checklist request — what are the allowed I-9 options for remote hires again? (video notary vs in-person at hub vs authorized agent)

raj (HR): Options:
1) In-person at Satellite Office (IDs accepted: passport + residence permit)
2) Remote notary (DE-accepted notary attestation + signed consent)
3) Local authorized agent (we maintain a list of vetted agents in Berlin)
I'll DM the vetted-agent list to @amelia.

dylan (IT): Once I-9 is cleared, ping me and I'll flip the device out of 'hold' and trigger MDM enrollment.

amelia (Recruiter): Thanks everyone — I'll confirm Asha's pickup preference and whether she emailed consent. Will update this thread after she replies. :thumbsup:
